label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Hey Mikaela, yep we did, started 21 Sept after mating had started. We’ve got 290 cows, mostly 3-way crossbreds. The real version is there’s definitely a production hit and we’ve had a bad mastitis one, but for us the time back has been worth it.

Going off the Fonterra app, milksolids are down about 6% on the same weeks last year. The rep had told us to expect 8–10%, so it’s not been quite as much as we’d braced for. Still 6% though, so not nothing.

Cells did jump. We were at about 110k and went up to around 180k for the first 3 weeks. They’re back around 135k now, so better but still up on where we started. We had a heifer with mastitis go bad on a skipped afternoon and didn’t spot it until the next morning. She lost a quarter. That was a hard one and I wouldn’t want to gloss over it. You really have to be on your game with teat spraying and checking cows on the skip days or it bites you.

We skip Tues, Thurs and Sat afternoon milkings and Sunday arvo too, so four once-a-days a week. Still 5.15 every morning! The cows came round quicker than I thought they would. About four days of bellowing at the gate and then they were fine.

The lame cows are way down, which has been a big one for us with the 1.8km walk to the back paddocks. We’ve got 4 on the lame list now compared with 11 this time last year. Whether that’s all down to the milking I couldn’t say, but it’s been good to see.

And the hours have made a huge difference. First Sunday arvo we skipped, Dave and I went to Hamilton to see the grandkids. First Sunday off in spring in 20-odd years! Kieran reckons it’s the first spring he hasn’t wanted to quit by October, which probably says it all.

Honestly I wouldn’t go back, the hours alone are worth the 6% to us. If Tom’s knees are as bad as you say I reckon the arvos off would help him more than anything. But that’s our experience and I wouldn’t want to tell you there’s no downside, especially after that heifer.

Come have a look at our shed rosters and numbers at the field day on the 19th if you like. Or ring me any time, much easier than texting!
